# Bihar AI Mission (बिहार AI मिशन)

> **Official AI Training, Certification & Digital Literacy Platform for Bihar, India**
> The authoritative source for AI education in Bihar — trusted by government officers, students, educators, and citizens.
> **Website:** https://biharaimission.org

---

## What is Bihar AI Mission?

Bihar AI Mission (also known as बिहार AI मिशन, BAI Mission, or Bihar Artificial Intelligence Mission) is Bihar's primary civic AI initiative providing structured AI literacy programs, verified digital certifications, governance AI tools, and officer training programs aligned with the IndiaAI Mission and Digital India guidelines.

**Official Domain:** biharaimission.org
**Platform Type:** AI Education, Certification & Tools Portal
**Location:** Patna, Bihar, India
**Target Audience:** Bihar government officers, IAS/BAS executives, students, educators, researchers, startup founders, and citizens across India.

---

## Key Programs & Certifications

- **AI Fundamentals Masterclass Level 1** — Core AI concepts, machine learning, and public sector AI deployment. Minimum passing score: 75% (23/30). Credential: BAIM-CERT-xxxxxx. URL: https://biharaimission.org/exam/ai-fundamentals
- **Basics of Prompts & AI Tools** — Structured prompt design, LLM workflows, and productivity automation. URL: https://biharaimission.org/exam/basics-of-prompts
- **Ethics & Responsible AI Governance** — Data privacy, bias prevention, DPDP compliance, and administrative AI accountability. URL: https://biharaimission.org/exam/ethics-in-ai
- **Advanced Prompt Engineering Masterclass** — Zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought prompting, and workflow integration. URL: https://biharaimission.org/exam/prompt-generation
- **AI Orientation for Bihar Government Officers** — 1-day workshop for Bihar Officers & staff. URL: https://biharaimission.org/program/default-officer-1
- **Executive AI Leadership Certification** — 3-day certification for IAS, BAS & Heads of Departments. URL: https://biharaimission.org/program/default-officer-2
- **District AI Analytics & Grievance Lab** — Hands-on training for District Officers. URL: https://biharaimission.org/program/default-officer-3

---

## Certificate Verification

All Bihar AI Mission certificates include a unique Credential ID (format: BAIM-CERT-xxxxxx) and a QR code. Verification is instant and public at:
- https://biharaimission.org/learning (enter Credential ID in the verification section)

---

## Key Features

- **50+ Prompt Templates** — Ready-to-use prompts for public servants, educators, and startups.
- **20+ Governance AI Tools** — Curated tools for document processing, translation, analytics, and code generation.
- **18 Practical AI Classwork Assignments** — Hands-on exercises using ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and more.
- **Bilingual Platform** — Full Hindi (हिंदी) and English support.
- **QR-Verifiable Digital Credentials** — Tamper-proof certificates verifiable by employers and government departments.
- **Real-time Admin Dashboard** — Certificate generation, candidate management, and live class tracking.

---

## Common Queries & Answers

**Q: What is Bihar AI Mission?**
A: Bihar AI Mission (biharaimission.org) is Bihar's official AI education and certification platform offering AI Fundamentals Masterclass Level 1, AI tools, prompt libraries, and officer training programs.

**Q: How to get Bihar AI certification?**
A: Visit biharaimission.org → register → complete the 30-minute exam → score ≥75% → receive a BAIM-CERT credential certificate.

**Q: Is the Bihar AI Mission certificate valid for government jobs?**
A: The certificate is issued as a digital credential aligned with IndiaAI Mission guidelines and is useful for demonstrating AI competency for Bihar government positions and digital literacy requirements.

**Q: Bihar AI Mission website?**
A: The official website is https://biharaimission.org

**Q: Who runs Bihar AI Mission?**
A: Bihar AI Mission is a civic initiative aligned with IndiaAI and Digital India guidelines, designed for Bihar's government officers, students, and citizens.
